_note: Copy to .superdesign/src/config.json. prefix: the root id ({{prefix}}-root). device: the phone frame in points (status bar, home indicator, tab bar, nav bar heights); every screen is device.width wide and at least device.height tall. platform: ios or android (drives the chrome partials you pick and the target size: 44 or 48). frame_width / frame_widths: canvas widths (the board is 1440). dark_pages: pages also built as <page>--dark (or "all"). brand_urls: Superdesign brand-asset URLs (upload.py), used as {{app-icon}}. forbidden: strings that must never ship. inject: partials appended before </body> on every screen. contract: warn | error | off for the React Native handoff checks. reference_pages: boards skipped by the handoff checks and the inventory. check_fonts: families measure.js and render.js require. routes: page -> expo-router file, read by block_inventory.py.
